program.name: Chin-up Strength
program.subject: Pull-ups
program.blurb: Chin-ups at the centre, with curls and presses one day and rows and legs the next.
program.about: Chin-ups at the centre of the program, the underhand grip that brings the biceps in. One day pairs them with curls and presses for the arms; the other with rows, hinges and squats for the back and legs. Straight sets with full rests. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for heavier weights and Level III brings harder bar moves.
